purpose: Locate the earliest observable claim-eligibility boundary reached by each already-frozen Candidate-58 machine record. This slice is descriptive diagnosis only: it does not infer semantic root cause, does not rerun the engine or C1, does not use truth/operator metadata, and cannot modify or reinterpret Gate2A scoring.

allowed_scientific_input: the exact frozen 58-row machine prediction matrix above
forbidden: Gate2A metrics as a classifier input
canonical expected labels or gold verdicts
kernel-result contents beyond the already-frozen tentative label copied into the machine record
C1-report contents beyond the already-frozen checker-output and assurance fields copied into the machine record

ordered_rules.interpretation: The frozen production driver terminated the case before primary adapter/C1 entry because frozen transport was incomplete. This is an observed execution boundary, not a semantic root-cause claim.

ordered_rules.predicate: promotion_reasons contains exactly one string beginning PRIMARY_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: and no other reason
ordered_rules.interpretation: The frozen production driver terminated the case before primary adapter/C1 entry because primary evidence preparation failed closed. The exception type is retained only as mechanical provenance, not semantic diagnosis.

ordered_rules.predicate: promotion_reasons is empty and tentative_kernel_prediction is E2_PREDICTED_ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE
ordered_rules.interpretation: The case reached the primary semantic chain, but the frozen kernel emitted no definitive claim. Gate2B0 does not inspect the semantic slice to say which A-F obligation caused that result.

ordered_rules.predicate: promotion_reasons is exactly [KERNEL_INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID] and tentative_kernel_prediction is INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID_BEFORE_PREDICTION
ordered_rules.interpretation: The kernel itself emitted infrastructure-invalid before a semantic claim.

ordered_rules.predicate: tentative_kernel_prediction is definitive, machine_prediction is E2_PREDICTED_ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE, and promotion_reasons is one of the frozen definitive-block promotion reason forms
ordered_rules.interpretation: A definitive kernel result existed but was not eligible for final promotion. This category names the boundary only; later slices may separate C1 support from disagreement.

ordered_rules.predicate: machine_prediction is definitive and equals tentative_kernel_prediction with VALID_C1 assurance
ordered_rules.interpretation: The frozen chain reached a definitive final claim; this is a reference category, not a failure.

frontier_taxonomy.fail_closed: Every matrix row must match exactly one ordered frontier rule. Zero matches, multiple matches, unknown reason atoms, malformed labels, or contradictory machine fields invalidate Gate2B0 instead of being assigned post hoc.

per_case: C1 checker-output and assurance fields as consistency-only observables
aggregate: no truth/operator/language strata in this first slice
forbidden_interpretation: calling a frontier a semantic root cause
claiming a remediation would fix a case
ranking obligations A-F before reading a separately authorized diagnostic surface
recomputing Gate2A accuracy, recall, coverage, or calibration
using truth favorability to choose or merge frontier categories

next_authorized_action: Implement a standard-library-only analyzer over only the exact frozen machine matrix and this protocol, freeze its exact blob identity, run two deterministic replays, require exact byte identity, and immutably commit the first complete frontier partition before opening any deeper semantic-slice diagnostic.
